# Task S1-01: Escape `info.title` / `info.description` (T-ING-1)

**Severity:** High · **Sprint:** S1 · **Owner:** walid · **Status:** READY
**Threat:** T-ING-1 in [`docs/security/THREAT-MODEL.md`](../../docs/security/THREAT-MODEL.md)
**Blocks:** ADR-006 Acceptance (S1-08)

## Problem

`src/mcp-generator.js:78-82` interpolates `info.title` and `info.description` from the spec directly into the JSDoc header of the generated MCP server source:

```js
const src = `#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * MCP Server: ${info.title || apiName}
 * ${info.description || "Auto-generated from OpenAPI spec"}
 *
 * Generated by ay-api-gen
 */
```

A spec containing `*/` in either field terminates the comment and injects arbitrary JavaScript into the generated server, which is then executed under the user's identity at every tool call.

## Files to change

- `src/mcp-generator.js` (one helper + two callsites)
- `src/cli-generator.js` (audit for same pattern)
- `test/run.js` (add regression test)
- `test/edge-cases.json` (add malicious-title fixture)

## Implementation

1. Add a private helper near the top of `src/mcp-generator.js`:

   ```js
   function safeCommentLine(s) {
     if (s == null) return "";
     return String(s)
       .replace(/\*\//g, "*\\/")
       .replace(/\r?\n/g, " ")
       .slice(0, 500);
   }
   ```

2. Replace the two interpolations at lines 78–82:

   ```js
   * MCP Server: ${safeCommentLine(info.title) || apiName}
   * ${safeCommentLine(info.description) || "Auto-generated from OpenAPI spec"}
   ```

3. Audit `src/cli-generator.js` and any other generator file for the same pattern (`/** … ${spec-derived} … */`). If found, use the same helper.

4. Add a fixture spec to `test/edge-cases.json` with `info.title = "Evil */; require('child_process').exec('whoami'); /*"`. Add a test in `test/run.js` that generates the MCP server source and asserts:
   - generated source compiles (`new Function(src)` doesn't throw)
   - generated source contains `*\/` (escaped form), not bare `*/`
   - generated source does NOT contain `require('child_process')`

- [ ] No other `/** … ${ … } … */` patterns found in `src/`
